releaseEvidence: The release's own acceptance.json (11 gates passed, 2 waived by the owner) and docs/chromium-beta-release.md, 'Owner gate decisions for beta.3' on chromium/next.

decisions: Show Blanc Beta on /download as the first of the page's tiles, in dark ink, right under the download (owner, 2026-11-14, with the page's reimagining); never a platform choice, so the regular Blanc stays the download.
The Download button goes to /dl/beta on the blanc-ping Worker, counted like the other /dl/* routes.
The section names both waived gates as limitations, matching the approved release notes.
Beta.3 (owner, 2026-11-14): the tile, its text and both limitations stay as for beta.2; only the release it names changes. Its release notes keep the caution that Sync isn't checked end to end.

claims.evidence: The release is built from the fork's Chromium 158 tree (release.json chromiumVersion 158.0.8127.2); the approved release notes say the same.

claims.text: It installs beside Blanc and never replaces it.
claims.evidence: Own bundle id me.bnfy.blanc.beta and Blanc Beta data folder (release.json); profile-coexistence gate passed on the notarized app; the owner's webauthn checks confirmed the Electron app and its passkeys were untouched.

claims.text: Apple Silicon Macs · macOS 13 or later · 2.0.0-beta.3
claims.evidence: release.json arches [arm64] under the owner's Intel waiver (renewed for beta.3), minimumSystemVersion 13.0, version 2.0.0-beta.3.

claims.text: Protected video, such as Netflix or Spotify.
claims.evidence: Listed under 'Not in this beta yet'. The beta ships without Widevine (enable_widevine = false); the no-drm-handoff gate is waived by the owner again for beta.3 (the notice is due in beta.4).

claims.text: Sync checked against the live Sync service.
claims.evidence: Listed under 'Not in this beta yet'. The owner's real-iPhone pass on the notarized beta.3 failed (the beta publishes no open tabs; joining shows no what-will-sync step), so production-sync-real-device is waived by the owner for beta.3; the Settings lockout fix itself passed there.
Listed under 'Not in this beta yet'. The release ships arm64 only; no fork build exists for Windows or Linux.
